A few gestures to get started:
Switches the mode; ⋮ next to a mode opens its rules and settings.
The drawer with all apps and folders.
Layout editing: widgets, moving, removing. An icon dropped onto another icon creates a folder.
Add to a mode or folder, remove, app info.
Each mode has its own card: apps and widgets for one situation — work, home, travel. I\'ll show you the most important gestures in a minute.
Swipe up or tap the “Search” field. In the drawer, swiping sideways switches to Folders.
Swipe down: the left half of the screen opens notifications, the right half — quick settings.

ON key (in the corner of the bottom bar): tap = list of modes and Settings, hold = arc of modes — slide your finger along the arc and release on the one you want. On the “Modes” widget you turn the dial. A mode can also suggest itself — at set times, by Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or in a given place.
Long-press an empty spot or any item. Then you drag items, resize them with the corner handle, and ⚙ opens the widget\'s settings. ✓ saves, ✕ undoes changes.

In edit mode, drop an icon onto an icon — a folder is created. A widget onto a widget — a widget stack; you switch between them by swiping vertically or with the dotted handle on the right. Dropping onto the bar at the top removes the item from the card.
Swipe sideways to change the page. In edit mode, hold a dragged item near the left or right edge — the page scrolls and the item moves with you. The Home button returns to the first one.
You can watch the tutorial again in Settings. Happy arranging 🙂
